verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is an opt-out from having data used for AI model training. That is an adjacent privacy control, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack documents a setting to disable telemetry or usage data collection, and the community note about agreeing to telemetry terms in the preview does not show any opt-out exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
